title.rendered: Generous Giving For Sherwood 4 Kids Sake

content.rendered: The Archer Glen community was so generous in giving to this year’s Sherwood 4 Kids Sake Giving Tree. Over 220 gifts were purchased for Sherwood area children and teens by Archer Glen families and staff. Many families will have a brighter Christmas due to the love our community poured out this season.
